label: On arbitrary accessibility, actual contingency of p, boxed truth of q and boxed q→p are inconsistent
paraphrase: On arbitrary accessibility, actual contingency of p, boxed truth of q and boxed q→p are inconsistent. Three universal two-world controls delete each policy in turn, retaining the other two; p and q are actually true in each control. Inclusion-minimality is conditional on this common modal interpretation; no member is independently established.
